title: Check: Reactions of Acids with Carbonates (B)

questions.stem: What is the test for carbon dioxide gas?

options.text: Hold a glowing splint and it relights
Add universal indicator and it turns purple
Bubble it through limewater; it turns milky
Hold a burning splint and listen for a squeaky pop

questions.explanation: The test for carbon dioxide is to bubble the gas through limewater (calcium hydroxide solution). If CO₂ is present, the limewater turns milky or cloudy due to the formation of insoluble calcium carbonate: CO₂ + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCO₃ + H₂O.
